profile_deletion.title: Delete this local profile?
profile_deletion.description: Permanently removes your local chats, drafts, saved API key, PIN, recovery code, limits and spending records. Old conversations cannot be recovered through the new profile.
profile_deletion.remote_notice: Local deletion does not revoke your OpenRouter key or delete your account. Requests already sent may still be charged.
profile_deletion.local_notice: Anyone with access to this screen can confirm deletion. Your PIN is not required.
profile_deletion.backup_notice: External exports and backups are kept. Secure erasure of all device copies is not guaranteed.
profile_deletion.progress: Deleting this local profile. Please wait before setting up a new one.
profile_deletion.unavailable: Deletion was accepted but has not finished. Choose Finish deletion or restart Tokenlogue. New setup will open after deletion completes.
profile_deletion.success: The local profile has been deleted. Set up Tokenlogue again.
profile_deletion.preparation_notice: After confirmation, Tokenlogue will restrict access to its own data folder before deleting this profile. If deletion cannot start, the profile is kept and the folder stays private.
profile_deletion.not_started: Deletion has not started. Return to sign-in and try again. If the error continues, restart Tokenlogue.
profile_deletion.directory_unsafe: Deletion has not started. This data folder cannot be used safely. Keep its files and ask for help.
profile_deletion.backend_before: Deletion has not started. Unlock your system key storage, then try again or restart Tokenlogue.
profile_deletion.changed_before: The profile changed. Deletion has not started. Return to sign-in and open a new confirmation.
profile_deletion.prepared_before: Deletion has not started. Your data is kept and its folder is now private. Return to sign-in and try again.
profile_deletion.ownership_before: Deletion has not started. Close other Tokenlogue windows, then try again.
